facts.event: Elise 召集猎手、持矛侍从和父亲的贵族，把他们带回 Isen 所去的山谷。
facts.relation: Elise 与 Isen 的兄妹关系；与父亲 Liran 的君臣/父女关系
facts.anchor: rallying them back to the valley where Isen had gone

facts.event: Elise 赶到时只见 Isen 的残躯：左腿扭断、满脸是血、一条手臂已断落远处。
facts.relation: Elise 与 Isen 的兄妹关系
facts.anchor: One arm was gone. It lay some distance from him amongst the green

facts.event: Conrin 在谷底抱着 Isen 哭喊“Brother-hyem”，这是他自婴儿后再没叫过的称呼。
facts.relation: Conrin 与 Isen 的兄弟关系
facts.anchor: ‘Brother-hyem!’ cried Conrin, though he had not said that since he was a babe.

facts.event: Liran 嘶吼着 Isen 的名字，跌跪在爱子身旁，称他为“我的战士孩子”。
facts.relation: Liran 与 Isen 的父子关系（最宠爱的儿子）
facts.anchor: His voice cracked as he fell to his knees beside his favourite. ‘My warrior child!’

facts.event: Isen 咽气；Egil 扑进 Elise 怀里，低声说没有 Isen 一切都会变。
facts.relation: Egil 与 Elise 的姐弟关系；Egil 与 Isen 的兄弟关系

facts.event: 众人不吹号、不庆功，把黑王子遗体运回堡垒；Alar 接管指挥，命女人把尸体送往河边的冷屋。
facts.relation: Alar 与 Isen 的兄弟关系；Alar 与 Elise 的兄妹关系
facts.numbers: the cold house down beside the river
facts.anchor: Alar took command, telling the women to take Isen’s body to the cold house down beside the river

facts.event: 女人们为 Isen 洗尸；Ysel 拿鞣革针，小心地把王子的断臂缝接回去。
facts.relation: Ysel 与 Isen 的亲属/侍从关系
facts.anchor: always pragmatic as she took a tanning needle and, very carefully, began to reattach the prince’s arm

facts.event: Tilde 私下告诉 Elise 自己曾叫 Isen 往上爬、试图警告他，并否认是林中巫术所为。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Elise 的继母/王后与公主关系，兼有旧情
facts.numbers: I tried to warn him; the forest doesn’t have a will of its own
facts.anchor: ‘The forest doesn’t have a will of its own.’
